subtopics.title: Orographic Rain and the Rain Shadow

questions.question: Orographic rain forms when:
options: Warm air sinks into a valley
Moist air is forced to rise over mountains, cools and condenses

questions.question: The side of a mountain facing the wind is called the:
Why is the leeward side dry?
options: It is always closer to the sea
The descending air warms and has already lost much of its moisture

questions.question: A berg wind in South Africa is:
options: Hot and dry, flowing down from the interior

questions.question: Durban gets about 1 000 mm of rain a year and Mthatha about:
Why does Mthatha get less rain than Durban?
options: Mthatha is beside a cold current
Moist sea air drops much of its rain on higher ground nearer the coast
Mthatha is closer to the equator

questions.question: Mthatha is cooler than Durban mainly because of:
options: Its altitude, distance from the sea and lack of a warm current
